note: Overlay: forces the SECONDARY bridge.get_discussion fetch for test-ako-post to a 503 error. The post route fetches discussion in a Promise.allSettled and tolerates its failure (discussionData=null), so the article must still render. Exercises graceful degradation on partial server-fetch failure (Obszar 7). Patches the base entry by its recorded requestHash. See ssrErrorFallback.spec.ts.
